title: GINGER: Spicing Up Graph-Based Vector Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.08306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present \textsc{Ginger}, a state-of-the-art open-source C++ library for graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). We developed \textsc{Ginger} at Google to push the speed and memory efficiency of graph search on large and high-dimensional embedding datasets. \textsc{Ginger} surpasses existing ANNS libraries with regards to query throughput and indexing time while matching the memory footprint of the most space-efficient competitors.   \textsc{Ginger} builds upon recent advances in proximity graph construction (PiPNN) and vector quantization (TurboQuant). We introduce Nested TurboQuant (NTQ), a two-level quantizer which supports low precision graph navigation and high precision reranking in a single code. This representation achieves near floating point precision with $2.6\times$ less memory. We also compress the size of our proximity graphs by up to $2.5\times$ without impacting query throughput. translated_title: GINGER：为基于图的向量搜索增添风味
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GINGER，一个用于基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）的最先进开源C++库。我们在谷歌开发了GINGER，旨在提升图搜索在大型高维嵌入数据集上的速度和内存效率。GINGER在查询吞吐量和索引构建时间方面超越了现有的ANNS库，同时其内存占用与最节省空间的竞争者相当。GINGER建立在近邻图构建和向量量化领域的最新进展之上。我们提出了嵌套TurboQuant（NTQ），这是一种两级量化器，可在同一套代码中同时支持低精度的图导航和高精度的重排序。这种表示方式以减少2.6倍内存的代价实现了接近浮点数的精度。我们还将近邻图的规模压缩了最多2.5倍，且不影响查询吞吐量。我们结合图重排序（原文在此截断）。
tldr: GINGER是谷歌开源的基于图的近似最近邻搜索C++库，通过嵌套TurboQuant（NTQ）两级量化与近邻图压缩技术，在节省最多2.6倍内存的同时实现了领先的查询吞吐量和索引构建速度。
en_tdlr: GINGER is a state-of-the-art open-source C++ library for graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search that surpasses existing ANNS libraries in query throughput and indexing time while reducing memory usage up to 2.6× through Nested TurboQuant quantization and up to 2.5× through proximity graph compression.
